_about: Sentences from a student's cold email to a professor, labelled by whether they claim contact that already happened. Collected 2026-09-30 from the review verifier's lists and an adversarial probe (three writing lenses, every reported miss re-judged independently). A claim of prior contact makes a generated draft fall back to the template; a missed one lets invented history reach a professor.
